questions.question_text: Who was the first Governor-General of independent Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Muhammad Ali Jinnah served as the first Governor-General of Pakistan from August 1947 until his death in September 1948.

questions.question_text: In which year was the first Constitution of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan promulgated?
questions.explanation: Pakistan's first constitution was adopted on March 23, 1956, officially turning the country into an Islamic republic.

questions.question_text: Which mountain range separates Pakistan from China?
questions.explanation: The Karakoram mountain range spans the borders of Pakistan, China, and India, and includes K2, the second highest peak in the world.

questions.question_text: What is the total length of Pakistan's coastline along the Arabian Sea approximately?
questions.explanation: Pakistan has a coastline of about 1,046 kilometers along the Arabian Sea in the provinces of Sindh and Balochistan.

questions.question_text: Who composed the national anthem of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The tune of the national anthem of Pakistan was officially composed by Ahmed G. Chagla in 1950.

questions.question_text: When was the Objective Resolution passed by the Constituent Assembly of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The Objectives Resolution was passed on March 12, 1949, under the leadership of Liaquat Ali Khan.

questions.question_text: Which desert is located in the eastern part of Pakistan's Punjab province?
questions.explanation: The Cholistan Desert is situated in southern Punjab, Pakistan, and is part of the larger Thar Desert.

questions.question_text: Who was the architect of the Lucknow Pact of 1916?

questions.question_text: What is the highest peak in Pakistan?
questions.explanation: K2 is the highest peak in Pakistan and the second highest in the world, located in the Karakoram range.

questions.question_text: In which city was the All India Muslim League founded in 1906?
questions.explanation: The All India Muslim League was founded on December 30, 1906, during the annual meeting of the Muhammadan Educational Conference in Dhaka.

questions.question_text: Which river is the longest river in Pakistan?
questions.explanation: The Indus River is the longest river in Pakistan, flowing from Tibet through Kashmir and down to the Arabian Sea.

questions.question_text: When did Pakistan become a member of the United Nations (UN)?
questions.explanation: Pakistan officially joined the United Nations on September 30, 1947.

questions.question_text: Which pass connects Pakistan with Afghanistan through the Hindu Kush mountain range?
questions.explanation: The Khyber Pass is a historic mountain pass connecting Pakistan and Afghanistan.

questions.question_text: What is the official national flower of Pakistan?
questions.explanation: Jasminum officinale, commonly known as white jasmine, is the national flower of Pakistan.
